purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_import_enclosure.py: native OBJ import of the EnclosureV1 parts (future Temple Mount wall 3000 x 3000 amot with five gates, cheil slab and wall, soreg band, optional book-proportion steps) generated offline by Scripts/create_mount_enclosure.py, assignment of EXISTING canonical materials, BlockAll collision through complex-as-simple, and placement as a separate toggleable actor folder Release/Enclosure in the combined map. Nothing here claims visual, walking, performance or packaged acceptance. The frozen section is written by `python Scripts/release_import_enclosure.py --freeze` after the generated files were reviewed; offline_check() refuses to run when the files on disk differ from it.
targetMapNote: The Walkthrough map carries the measured architecture, the Jerusalem context (Buildings 1498, Streets 2877, Terrain 256 actors) and the FutureMountV1/Platform deck (2 actors, top Z 0) per release-inventory-20260907T173546Z.json. L_FutureMount is protected and never loaded.
toggleNote: All actors live under the outliner folder Release/Enclosure/<group> and carry the tag ReleaseEnclosureV1, so the whole future enclosure can be hidden or shown as one layer without touching any city, terrain or platform actor. No existing actor is moved, hidden or deleted.

deliberateOmissions.steps: The measured scene already carries the 12 east (SM_0261..0272) and 7 north/south (SM_0357..0363, SM_0458..0464) gateway stairs at the same threshold planes. The book-proportion step slabs (0.5 x 0.5 amah, last step 4.5 deep) are imported for comparison but NOT placed by default; -EnclosureGroups=steps would be refused by the clearance check unless the measured stairs are hidden first.

sourceReference: Lishchno Tidreshu pp. 113, 115-118 (wall 6 x 6, 3000 x 3000 amot, five gates 10 x 50, Temple near the NW: 500 W / 501 N), pp. 119-126 (soreg 10 tefachim, cheil wall 10 amot + 10 amot open, 12/7 steps), pp. 359-363 (500 x 500 reeds measured from outside; Rashi 42:20 cheil wall around the whole mountain; author's starred 500-amot soreg ring). Research: SourceAssets/research/book-scene-requirements-20260907.md section 1, gap 3.

source.namespaceNote: The script refuses to import if the namespace directory already exists (never overwrite a native namespace); -EnclosurePlaceOnly verifies an existing import instead.

importSettings.note: Identical to the reviewed OBJ adapter path (create_heikhal_keilim.run_native; release_import_reliefs; release_import_doors): FbxFactory on the OBJ, import_materials False, auto_generate_collision False, one empty material slot per OBJ 'g' group. After import the mesh BodySetup is set to CTF_USE_COMPLEX_AS_SIMPLE (as import_mount_platform.py / import_buildings_ue58.py) so the BlockAll component profile blocks on the actual box geometry.

collision.note: BlockAll via complex-as-simple on every enclosure mesh; the walker collides with the wall/gate boxes, the cheil wall and the soreg band; the 5 cm cheil slab is a walkable lip.

materials.rule: First candidate that exists on disk and loads as a MaterialInterface is assigned to EVERY slot of the mesh (one slot per OBJ group). No material is created or duplicated. Falling past the first candidate is recorded as a limitation.

stone.use: wall chunks, gate piers/lintels, cheil wall, steps

candidates.kind: canonical stone of the measured architecture (architecture manifest slot M_stone_16ec6ebc63 -> M_Canonical_stone per canonical-material-review.json; original material of the inner gate jamb SM_0138 per jerusalem-stone-v2-wall review)
Jerusalem stone V2 wall review pilot (fallback)
canonical paving of the measured courts
canonical dark cedar (already on 52 architecture slots)

windingCheck.note: GeometryScript readback of the imported LOD0 (copy_mesh_from_static_mesh_v2 + get_triangle_face_normal, as release_import_doors.py). Every authored part is a closed box with positive canonical volume, so the divergence volume with UE face normals must be positive and equal the manifest part-volume sum. Needs -EnablePlugins=GeometryScripting; without a pass nothing is placed unless -EnclosureAllowUnverifiedWinding is given (recorded).

platform.rule: The cheil, soreg and steps groups stand on the future platform deck (design Z policy platform_deck_z0). Before placing them the script requires at least one actor in this folder whose world bounds top is within deckTopToleranceCm of 0 and whose XY bounds contain every ring footprint; otherwise those groups become recorded omissions and only wall/gates are placed.

clearance.rule: Ring groups: any overlapping small actor (or union constituent box) is a blocker and aborts the placement (all spawned actors destroyed). Wall/gates: overlaps with city/terrain actors are EXPECTED (the book's 1500 m square covers the modern city, which is the comparison context); they are counted and listed in the receipt as cityOverlap, never treated as blockers. Actors with an extent above largeActorExtentCm (terrain tiles, platform, instanced batches) are envelope-only.

verification.compareRule: Numeric location/rotation/scale fields and AABB corners only; str(Transform) is never compared.

limitations: Traces return nothing in commandlets; no native grounding is attempted. Wall and gate base heights come from the offline source DEM triangles (enclosure-design.json terrainSampledZcm); the future terrain is unknown and the current city DEM is only the comparison datum.

The 3000-amot wall (1500 m square) crosses the modern city model: buildings, streets and trees intersect the wall and gate boxes. This is inherent to the book's layout; the receipt lists the intersecting actors and the enclosure folder can be hidden as one layer.

Gate positions along the walls, the 60-amot piers/lintel, the soreg distance and the cheil-wall openings are assumptions or the author's starred suggestions (see enclosure-design.json uncertainties). Gate doors are not modelled.
The soreg is a solid 25 cm band, not a lattice; the cheil slab is a 5 cm lip on the deck.

Import, material assignment and placement are geometric only; no visual, lighting, LOD, performance or packaged acceptance is established. The 60-amot gate piers and the 32 wall chunks add 37 large actors to the city view frustum; culling behaviour is unverified.

frozen.note: Written by release_import_enclosure.py --freeze after review of the generated files; offline_check() recomputes it and refuses to run if the files differ.
